description: This file defines a class 'CompoundPredicateBuilderController' that manages the state and behavior of a predicate builder UI component, including observable properties, predicate manipulation methods, and state resetting.

classes.name: CompoundPredicateBuilderController
classes.description: A controller class managing predicate logical operators and predicate list for building complex search/filter queries.

methods.name: setOperator
methods.description: Sets the logical operator ('and'/'or') for predicate combination.

methods.name: setPredicate
methods.description: Updates a specific predicate at the given index with new values.

methods.name: changePredicateKeypath
methods.description: Changes the keypath of a predicate and resets its value based on the new keypath type.

methods.name: addPredicate
methods.description: Adds a new empty predicate to the predicates list.

methods.name: removePredicate
methods.description: Removes the predicate at the specified index.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the current predicate state into a PredicateJsonForm object.

methods.name: resetState
methods.description: Resets the operator and predicates to initial default state.
